title: Special Card
description: The offer panel the live Specials archive renders — one full-width card per special, the property photograph carried as the card's own ground under a heavy scrim, with the offer name in Joe Hand script, the terms as running copy, and an enquiry button. It is the only card on the site whose title is script rather than heading type, and the only one that is full-width rather than gridded. Measured from `.post-type-archive-lsx-to-special #primary .lsx-to-archive-item` on 2026-08-20: title #E6AD10 Joe Hand 36px weight 300, left-aligned, margin-bottom 0; the photograph set as a background-image on the article itself. The scrim is this theme's addition — live sets the title in gold directly over an undimmed photograph, where it measured 1.9:1 against the lighter frames and was unreadable on several live specials. The optional corner badge is live's `.special-tag`: an 80px accent-500 plate on the trailing edge carrying a short uppercase label. Structure note (2026-09-17, its first consumer): the band stacks its media and its body in **one CSS grid cell** rather than absolutely positioning the body over the image. Both read identically at desktop widths, but the grid row grows to the taller of the two, so a long offer name or a long description pushes the band taller instead of overflowing it — and it does that at every viewport width without a media query, which this `css` field silently unwraps and could not hold anyway. The band also paints a neutral-900 ground of its own. That is the no-image fallback (spec edge case): `core/post-featured-image` renders **nothing at all** for an offer with no featured image, so without it the band would collapse to the height of its own body and set base-coloured text over the page. With it, such an offer reads as a dark panel — legible, and obviously an offer — rather than as a broken one.

styles.css: & { display: grid; overflow: hidden; } & > * { grid-area: 1 / 1; margin-block: 0 !important; } & .special-card__media { margin: 0 !important; line-height: 0; align-self: stretch; } & .special-card__media img { width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 100%; object-fit: cover; } & .special-card__body { margin: 0 !important; z-index: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; padding: var(--wp--preset--spacing--50); } & .special-card__body p { line-height: var(--wp--custom--line-height--body); } & .special-card__badge { position: absolute; inset-block-start: 0; inset-inline-end: 0; z-index: 2; margin: 0 !important; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; text-align: center; width: 80px; height: 80px; padding: var(--wp--preset--spacing--10); background-color: var(--wp--preset--color--accent-500); } & .special-card__badge p { margin: 0; color: var(--wp--preset--color--neutral-900); font-family: var(--wp--preset--font-family--heading); font-size: var(--wp--preset--font-size--100); font-weight: var(--wp--custom--font-weight--bold); line-height: var(--wp--custom--line-height--snug); letter-spacing: var(--wp--custom--letter-spacing--heading); text-transform: uppercase; }
